title: Unit Event — Aim Higher and Higher! — Episode4 The Same Feeling

meta.Event Outline: The day of Taiga and Ken's event has finally arrived. The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD are looking forward to this world-class event, when an incident leads to an unexpected reunion.

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The acidity and bitterness are exquisitely balanced. I can tell they pay close attention not only to the quality of their beans, but to the preparation as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This whipped cream on top isn't too sweet either, so it works really well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mmm... Their cafe au lait's good stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I'm glad you're all enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Your drinks were made using the beans Ceddy always gets, Toya, Kohane! So, it's nice to hear that they're to your liking!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You and I may have a lot in common, Cedric.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You also mentioned that you can purchase beans here, so I'd appreciate it if you showed me which ones later.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've had a chance to properly reintroduce ourselves, let's get down to business.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... You're talking about how you two know RADder, yes?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
That's right.
Still, where do we begin...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna hear it all! For example, how did you two meet Aunt Nagi and her team?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
How we first met?
Actually, it's not all that different from the way we met all of you today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you mean, they helped get your wallet back after somebody stole it?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Oh, no. Not like that.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We tried to steal Taiga's wallet.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Slade, don't start there...
They have no idea how to react.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry, my bad!
Yeah, that would be pretty shocking, huh!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: In our defense, that attempt ended in failure. Still, we know it was bad, and we regret it a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But why...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: The truth is, when we were little, our family was really poor... For a while there, we couldn't even put food on the table.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: One day, we were absolutely starving. That was when we spotted RADder...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: They looked like rich tourists, so we decided to try picking their pockets.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: But we ended up failing spectacularly.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: They grabbed us by the scruffs of our necks and gave us looks that'd strip paint.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Remember Taiga's face?
He was so scary.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I can just picture it...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Then, just when we thought they were going to clobber us, they said, “Promise to never do this again and we'll let you go.”

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Now that we're older, we understand that they could probably tell our situation wasn't the greatest...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Anyway, they began asking us a bunch of questions.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: If we had parents, and how we were getting by each day.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: We didn't tell them anything at first, since we figured they didn't actually care at all.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: But those three did care. Nagi in particular seemed genuinely worried. Eventually, we felt comfortable telling them everything.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: That was the first time in our lives that grown-ups had actually asked if we were okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Anyway, after they learned about how we were living, they told us to come hear them sing.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: They invited us to the event they were scheduled to perform in.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Taiga said, “It won't put food in your stomachs, but it might put some meaning in your lives.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so like him.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We replied that there was no point if it didn't put food in our stomachs, and he got really mad at us.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Back then, to us, all music just sounded like pointless noise.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: But they kept insisting that we go...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
And when we heard them sing...
Our lives were changed forever.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: It probably sounds like we're exaggerating, but it's all true.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Until that day, all the sounds of the city had just felt like noise. But the way they sang was...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: It was amazing.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We learned the true meaning of having your heart moved.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Music. Singing.
We learned that those things have the power to light a fire inside of you.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: That moment changed us forever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Music changed their lives.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That sounds like...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So RADder lit a fire inside you two too.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Yup...
Since then, it's been music sunup to sundown, 24/7!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We began practicing like there was no tomorrow, because we wanted to sing just like them!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We even begged them to give us lessons every time they came over here!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Gradually, we started getting asked to perform at local venues. We even began streaming our own stuff.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. In the end, we're able to put food on the table just through our music now.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: We really can't thank those three enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your story is remarkable...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, now I remember...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Remember what, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember Dad and them saying how they'd taken a pair of twins over in the United States under their wings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They must've been referring to you two!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: They also told us about you, An.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Nagi loved to talk about this little girl she knew who was such a talented singer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great to hear...!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We even saw you as our rival!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: It sounded like you weren't too much younger than we were, so we got all fired up, like who does this kid think she is, getting all that praise!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Slade here kept saying, “RADder's only allowed to praise us!”
He was so jealous.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Imagine that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It sounds like you two were very close with them.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah... We wouldn't trade the time we got to spend with those three for anything.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: No, we wouldn't.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: So, An, this might not fully answer the question you asked us earlier...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: But to us, those three from RADder are our saviors, heroes and family!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: They gave us music... They showed us a new way to live. And most importantly, they taught us human compassion.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: That's why we want to see what lies beyond Nagi's dream.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Just like you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: The way you guys sang during RAD BLAST was so awesome. But...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We're gonna be the ones to see what lies beyond Nagi's dream!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's what you guys meant...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like all the dots have been connected now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I understand what you felt when music came into your lives for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even though you were entering uncharted waters... Even though you were experiencing something completely new...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After music... After singing came into my life, everything changed for me, too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The same applies to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How we were all touched by them may vary, but RADder's music has affected all of our lives. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're essentially the reason we're talking to each other right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like Aunt Nagi brought us all together!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Hey, since the event isn't gonna start for a bit, wanna browse the flea market together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: I mean, we're all going to the same place, right?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: And after talking with you guys, I'm sorta not ready to say goodbye yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, once we've finished these drinks, let's head back over there!
